_what: The shape Claude Code itself writes into ~/.claude/projects/<encoded>/<uuid>.jsonl, so the converter can be checked against Claude instead of against our own assumptions.
_why: The writer had no tests at all, and drifted: it stamped model 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514' and version '2.1.0' onto installs that had long since moved to claude-opus-5 and 2.1.24x, and it omitted gitBranch, diagnostics and stop_details entirely. Nothing noticed, because nothing compared our output to Claude's.

_derived_from.note: 'required' are the keys present in every sampled row of that type; everything else is listed as situational.

_refresh: Re-derive against a real ~/.claude/projects after a Claude Code upgrade: read the newest session files, split rows by 'type', intersect the key sets per type for 'required'. A stale fixture is visible and fixable; an assumption baked into a test is neither.
